text: dsh-better-command 是面向 DSH 网页端的斜杠菜单匹配插件。它向浏览器端提供 slashMatcher 服务，并将命令和技能来源的候选列表交给匹配器重新筛选排序。插件忽略名称与查询中的连字符、下划线、点号和空白，支持大小写无关的前缀、分隔符折叠前缀及按单词边界加权的子序列匹配，例如输入 dshp 可找到 dsh-plugin-creator，输入 dbc 可找到 dsh-better-command。适合经常使用斜杠命令或技能、希望通过缩写快速找到条目的 DSH 网页用户。无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-better-command improves the DSH web slash menu by ranking command and skill names. It ignores separators like hyphens and spaces, so short abbreviations can find longer names. No API key is needed.
想在 DSH 的斜杠菜单里用缩写找到长命令或技能名。
输入不带连字符的技能简称时，怎么让菜单也能匹配完整名称？
Can I find slash commands by typing an abbreviation instead of the full name?
dsh-better-command 的功能「缩写筛选斜杠候选」：在 DSH 网页端输入 `/` 后，命令和技能候选会按名称与输入内容进行匹配并排序。可输入连续缩写来找到带分隔符的名称，匹配结果优先显示完整前缀和单词边界更吻合的条目。
dsh-better-command 的功能「透明分隔符匹配」：搜索时，名称和查询里的连字符、下划线、点号及空白会被忽略。输入 `dshp` 可匹配 `dsh-plugin-creator`，并且只按候选名称匹配。

@lovstudio/dsh-better-command README · dsh-better-command：Lovstudio's slash-menu matching upgrade for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web surface. The plugin provides the `slashMatcher` service — a separator-transparent, abbreviation-aware candidate ranker — that the `/` menu sources (ui-commands and ui-skill) consult at candidate time. With the plugin mounted, `dshp` matches `dsh-plugin-creator`, `dbc` matches `dsh-better-command`, and `dsh-p` matches `dsh-plugin-creator`.
@lovstudio/dsh-better-command README · dsh-better-command：This is a **Lovstudio** plugin, not a DeepSeek-AI package, distributed under the `@lovstudio` scope.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-command README · What it does：The slash pipeline asks each `/` source for menu candidates per keystroke. The harness command source filters by ordered-subsequence matching; the skill source filters by literal name prefix — so a skill like `dsh-plugin-creator` is unreachable by typing `dshp`. Official harness builds expose no matcher extension point, so this plugin attaches itself at runtime: it reaches the `inputTriggers` registry, and for the `command` and `skill` sources replaces `candidates` with a wrapper that fetches the source's full list and ranks it with the plugin's matcher. Pick, space and enter adjudication are untouched. The matcher is also published as the `slashMatcher` service for sources that want to consult it directly.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-command README · What it does：- `-`, `_`, `.`, and whitespace are transparent in names and queries (`dshp` matches `dsh-plugin-creator`).
- Word-initial abbreviations score at boundaries (`dbc` matches `dsh-better-command`).
- Matching is case-insensitive and name-only; descriptions never match.
- Ranking tiers: literal prefix > separator-stripped prefix > boundary-weighted subsequence score; equal scores keep source order.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-command README · What it does：The plugin is fully self-contained: it imports no `@deepseek-ai` runtime symbols (the service contract is a structural mirror), and its browser half is served to the page by the client module system once composed.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-command README · Install：Prerequisites: Node.js 22.19+ or 24+, pnpm 11 (`corepack enable` or `npm i -g pnpm`) — `dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory.

**From a DeepSeek Harness source checkout (recommended — you get the harness source too):**

```sh
git clone --depth 1 --branch dsh-v0.1.2-rc.1 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness && pnpm install && pnpm run build
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:lovstudio/dsh-better-command#v0.1.2
pnpm dsh web

@lovstudio/dsh-better-command README · Install：**Without a checkout (npx; compiled harness only):**

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:lovstudio/dsh-better-command#v0.1.2
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

`web` is the profile `dsh web` boots. The tag pins a commit whose `lib/` is prebuilt and committed, so nothing is compiled on your machine. Verified on 2026-09-04 against `dsh-v0.1.2-rc.1`. Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove @lovstudio/dsh-better-command`.

@lovstudio/dsh-better-command README · Local development：Keep this checkout outside the DeepSeek Harness repository. Install and build it here, then link the package into an isolated development profile:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run watch

DSH_HOME=/Users/mark/.dsh-lov-dev pnpm --dir /path/to/deepseek-harness dsh plugin --profile web add -w link:/path/to/dsh-better-command

@lovstudio/dsh-better-command README · Local development：The browser module system consumes the generated `lib/client.js`, and the Harness Client HMR watcher detects rebuilds. Package-manifest, patch, and bundle-membership changes require a profile restart. The package build does not import a Harness tsconfig or workspace source path.
